title: OptChain: Achieving Optimal Throughput of Permissionless Blockchains
title_zh: OptChain：实现无许可区块链的最优吞吐量
abstract_en: We introduce \textit{OptChain}, a permissionless blockchain state machine replication (SMR) protocol that achieves optimal throughput. We first establish a theoretical upper bound on the throughput of any SMR protocol under a fixed error probability, and OptChain is the first protocol to approach this limit. Conceptually, OptChain is a sharding protocol that optimizes both vertical and horizontal scalability. Vertically, we introduce \textit{Shardis}, a novel permissionless verifiable information dispersal mechanism that maximizes intra-shard throughput to its physical limit, determined by the fastest node's bandwidth within each shard. Horizontally, we propose \textit{diffusion mining}, which ensures security as long as each shard includes at least one honest node, thereby allowing for the maximum number of shards. We provide a formal security and efficiency analysis, demonstrating that OptChain approaches the established upper bound while maintaining robust security. Finally, we implement a full prototype of OptChain and deploy it on AWS EC2 nodes across various regions. Experimental results indicate that OptChain outperforms state-of-the-art permissionless protocols and closely approaches the theoretical optimal throughput.
abstract_zh: 本文提出 OptChain，一种无许可区块链状态机复制（SMR）协议，目标是在固定错误概率下实现最优吞吐量。作者首先给出任意 SMR 协议吞吐量的理论上界，并证明 OptChain 是首个接近该极限的协议。OptChain 可理解为一种同时优化纵向与横向扩展性的分片协议：在纵向扩展上，提出 Shardis，一种新的无许可可验证信息分散机制（verifiable information dispersal），将分片内吞吐量提升到由该分片最快节点带宽决定的物理极限；在横向扩展上，提出 diffusion mining，使系统只要每个分片至少包含一个诚实节点即可保持安全，从而允许使用最大数量的分片。论文给出形式化安全性与效率分析，并实现完整原型，在 AWS EC2 跨区域节点上部署测试。实验表明，OptChain 优于现有先进无许可协议，并接近理论最优吞吐量。
key_points_zh: 建立固定错误概率下任意状态机复制（SMR）协议吞吐量的理论上界，并以此作为评估无许可区块链吞吐能力的基准。
提出 OptChain 分片架构，同时优化纵向扩展和横向扩展，是首个声称接近该吞吐上界的无许可区块链协议。
提出 Shardis，可验证信息分散机制，将分片内吞吐量推至由分片内最快节点带宽决定的物理极限。
提出 diffusion mining，使安全条件放宽为每个分片至少有一个诚实节点，从而支持最大化分片数量。
在 AWS EC2 多区域环境实现并测试完整原型，实验结果显示 OptChain 超越现有无许可协议并接近理论最优吞吐量。

llm_assessment.comment: Strong blockchain systems work, but it is largely outside the agent harness evolution scope.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一项很强的区块链系统研究，但基本不属于智能体框架演化范围。
